title: One dashboard. Faster response.
summary: Server visibility, remote management through ChatGPT, and an agent ready to investigate new alerts.

body.lead: Server visibility, remote management through ChatGPT, and an agent ready to investigate new alerts.

body.caption: 22-second overview. Illustrative dashboard data. No narration. Music: Sascha Ende, ende.app ([CC BY 4.0](https://ende.app/en/standard-license)).

body: Bring services, storage, network health and scheduled tasks into one view. Use ChatGPT MCP connectors to inspect and manage operations remotely through conversation.
An integrated agent investigates new alerts using logs and service health. Sensitive actions require approval, with activity and findings available for review.

ol: Record activity and findings for review.

body: A functional demonstration for personal and professional server operations. No measured response-time or savings claim is made.
